note: Denmark tax-benefit instrument map to governing Danish law. This is a bounded pilot: only the child and youth benefit is captured. Source URLs are hunting grounds (current in-force LBK consolidations verified against the retsinformation.dk search API and ELI graph on 2026-07-12), not captured provenance - capture happens in axiom-corpus manifests, with post-consolidation amendment diligence at capture time.

instruments.instrument: børne- og ungeydelse (child and youth benefit)
instruments.governing_law: Børne- og ungeydelsesloven, LBK nr 603 af 12/05/2025 (§ 1 amounts + regulation; § 1 a income taper), as amended by LOV nr 1642 af 16/12/2025 (§ 1, stk. 3 rounding divisor; § 2/§ 4/§ 11) and LOV nr 303 af 24/02/2026 (§ 4 e)

instruments.instrument: personskat (state personal income tax: bundskat, mellemskat from 2026, topskat, top-topskat)
instruments.governing_law: Personskatteloven (consolidated act; § 6-§ 7 c rates and bases, § 10 personfradrag, § 20 annual regulation)
instruments.note: The § 1 a taper base in the captured child-benefit act references personskattelovens § 7, stk. 1 og 3 (mellemskat base) and § 20 (regulation); capturing personskatteloven is the natural next scope. Note the consolidation lag: the newest LBK (nr 1284 af 14/06/2021) predates the 2023-2025 reform, so the 2026 mellemskat provisions live in later amendment acts that must be captured alongside it.
